TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP/SAT.lean.header: private lemma sat_guard_add {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (anchor : S) (c d : Cfg k Bool S x) (a b : ℕ) (ha : ∀ v < a, (tm.runFrom c v).state ≠ some anchor) (he : tm.runFrom c a = d) (hb : ∀ v < b, (tm.runFrom d v).state ≠ some anchor) : ∀ v < a + b, (tm.runFrom c v).state ≠ some anchor

private lemma sat_guard_add {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (anchor : S) (c d : Cfg k Bool S x) (a b : ℕ)
    (ha : ∀ v < a, (tm.runFrom c v).state ≠ some anchor)
    (he : tm.runFrom c a = d)
    (hb : ∀ v < b, (tm.runFrom d v).state ≠ some anchor) :
    ∀ v < a + b, (tm.runFrom c v).state ≠ some anchor := by
  intro v hv
  by_cases h : v < a
  · exact ha v h
  · have hva : a ≤ v := by omega
    rw [← Nat.add_sub_of_le hva, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, he]
    exact hb (v - a) (by omega)

TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP/SAT.lean.header: private lemma sat_bridge_bound (c A d n len : ℕ) (hlen : len ≤ A * (n + 1) ^ d) : c * (A * (n + 1) ^ d + n + len + 1) + 1 ≤ (c * (2 * A + 1) + 1) * (n + 1) ^ (d + 1)
TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP/SAT.lean.code:
private lemma sat_bridge_bound (c A d n len : ℕ) (hlen : len ≤ A * (n + 1) ^ d) :
    c * (A * (n + 1) ^ d + n + len + 1) + 1 ≤
      (c * (2 * A + 1) + 1) * (n + 1) ^ (d + 1) := by
  have hd := Nat.mul_le_mul_left A
    (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.succ_pos n) (show d ≤ d + 1 by omega))
  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] at hd
  have hn : n + 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ (d + 1) := by
    simpa using Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.succ_pos n) (show 1 ≤ d + 1 by omega)
  have h1 : 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ (d + 1) := by omega
  calc
    _ ≤ c * ((2 * A + 1) * (n + 1) ^ (d + 1)) + 1 := by
      apply Nat.add_le_add_right
      apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
      simp only [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul, Nat.mul_assoc, two_mul]
      omega
    _ ≤ c * ((2 * A + 1) * (n + 1) ^ (d + 1)) + (n + 1) ^ (d + 1) := Nat.add_le_add_left h1 _
    _ = _ := by ring

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Co.name: Turing.Segment.trans
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Co.header: theorem trans {a b c : Cfg k Γ S x} {t v : ℕ} (h : Segment M F P a b t) (g : Segment M F P b c v) : Segment M F P a c (t + v)
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Co.code:
theorem trans {a b c : Cfg k Γ S x} {t v : ℕ} (h : Segment M F P a b t)
    (g : Segment M F P b c v) : Segment M F P a c (t + v) := by
  refine ⟨by rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, h.1, g.1], ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro u hu
    by_cases hut : u < t
    · exact h.2.1 u hut
    · have he : u = t + (u - t) := by omega
      rw [he, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, h.1]
      exact g.2.1 _ (by omega)
  · intro u hu
    by_cases hut : u ≤ t
    · exact h.2.2 u hut
    · have he : u = t + (u - t) := by omega
      rw [he, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, h.1]
      exact g.2.2 _ (by omega)

    obtain rfl : u = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hu
    exact h⟩

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Co.header: private def counterSpan {k : ℕ} {Γ S : Type} {x : List Γ} (H : MultiTapeTM (k + 1) Γ (CounterLoopState S)) (z : Cfg (k + 1) Γ (CounterLoopState S) x) (t : ℕ) (cp : ℤ) (width : ℕ) (R : (Fin k → ℤ) → Prop) : Prop
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Co.code:
private def counterSpan {k : ℕ} {Γ S : Type} {x : List Γ}
    (H : MultiTapeTM (k + 1) Γ (CounterLoopState S))
    (z : Cfg (k + 1) Γ (CounterLoopState S) x) (t : ℕ) (cp : ℤ) (width : ℕ)
    (R : (Fin k → ℤ) → Prop) : Prop :=
  (∀ u < t, (H.runFrom z u).state ≠ some .done ∧
    (H.runFrom z u).state ≠ some .escape) ∧
  (∀ u ≤ t, (H.runFrom z u).workTapePos (Fin.last k) ∈
    Finset.Icc (cp - 1) (cp + (width : ℤ))) ∧
  (∀ u ≤ t, R (fun j => (H.runFrom z u).workTapePos j.castSucc))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Co.name: Turing.counterSpan_iff_segment
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Co.header: private lemma counterSpan_iff_segment {k : ℕ} {Γ S : Type} {x : List Γ} (H : MultiTapeTM (k + 1) Γ (CounterLoopState S)) (z : Cfg (k + 1) Γ (CounterLoopState S) x) (t : ℕ) (cp : ℤ) (width : ℕ) (R : (Fin k → ℤ) → Prop) : counterSpan H z t cp width R ↔ Segment H {some .done, some .escape} (fun p => p (Fin.last k) ∈ Finset.Icc (cp - 1) (cp + (width : ℤ)) ∧ R fun j => p j.castSucc) z (H.runFrom z t) t
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Co.code:
private lemma counterSpan_iff_segment {k : ℕ} {Γ S : Type} {x : List Γ}
    (H : MultiTapeTM (k + 1) Γ (CounterLoopState S))
    (z : Cfg (k + 1) Γ (CounterLoopState S) x) (t : ℕ) (cp : ℤ) (width : ℕ)
    (R : (Fin k → ℤ) → Prop) :
    counterSpan H z t cp width R ↔
      Segment H {some .done, some .escape}
        (fun p => p (Fin.last k) ∈ Finset.Icc (cp - 1) (cp + (width : ℤ)) ∧
          R fun j => p j.castSucc)
        z (H.runFrom z t) t := by
  rw [Turing.segment_iff]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨hc, hh, hr⟩ => ⟨rfl, fun u hu hm => Or.elim hm (hc u hu).1 (hc u hu).2,
      fun u hu => ⟨hh u hu, hr u hu⟩⟩,
    fun ⟨_, hc, hp⟩ =>
      ⟨fun u hu => ⟨fun h => hc u hu (Or.inl h), fun h => hc u hu (Or.inr h)⟩,
        fun u hu => (hp u hu).1, fun u hu => (hp u hu).2⟩⟩

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Robustne.name: Turing.FinTM.DGSpan
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Robustne.header: private def DGSpan {A Q : Type} {x : List A} (tm : MultiTapeTM 1 A Q) (c d : Cfg 1 A Q x) (t : ℕ) (lo hi : ℤ) : Prop
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Robustne.code:
private def DGSpan {A Q : Type} {x : List A} (tm : MultiTapeTM 1 A Q)
    (c d : Cfg 1 A Q x) (t : ℕ) (lo hi : ℤ) : Prop :=
  tm.runFrom c t = d ∧ ∀ u ≤ t,
    lo ≤ (tm.runFrom c u).workTapePos 0 ∧ (tm.runFrom c u).workTapePos 0 ≤ hi

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Robustne.header: private lemma dgSpan_iff_segment {A Q : Type} {x : List A} (tm : MultiTapeTM 1 A Q) (c d : Cfg 1 A Q x) (t : ℕ) (lo hi : ℤ) : DGSpan tm c d t lo hi ↔ Segment tm ∅ (fun p => lo ≤ p 0 ∧ p 0 ≤ hi) c d t
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Robustne.code:
private lemma dgSpan_iff_segment {A Q : Type} {x : List A} (tm : MultiTapeTM 1 A Q)
    (c d : Cfg 1 A Q x) (t : ℕ) (lo hi : ℤ) :
    DGSpan tm c d t lo hi ↔ Segment tm ∅ (fun p => lo ≤ p 0 ∧ p 0 ≤ hi) c d t := by
  rw [Turing.segment_iff]
  exact ⟨fun h => ⟨h.1, fun _ _ hm => hm, h.2⟩, fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2.2⟩⟩
